title: The Relationship Addition Set on a Late Payment Fee Correction
content:
A relationship addition is set on a correction to a late payment fee billed under Personal Credit Cards from the card purchases that have posted to that card account and the ledger balance of the cardholder's Personal Checking account.

1. A relationship addition of 4.00 USD is set where card purchases posted to this card account in the last twelve months total at least 9000.00 USD and the cardholder's active Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account carries a ledger balance of at least 5000.00 USD.

2. A relationship addition of 2.00 USD is set where those purchases total at least 4000.00 USD but less than 9000.00 USD and that ledger balance is at least 1000.00 USD.

3. In every other case no relationship addition is made.

**Both parts, in combination.**

| Card purchases in the last twelve months | Ledger balance on the active checking account | Relationship addition |
|---|---|---|
| 12000.00 USD | 6200.00 USD | 4.00 USD |
| 12000.00 USD | 2000.00 USD | none |
| 9000.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 4.00 USD |
| 8900.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 2.00 USD |
| 4000.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | 2.00 USD |
| 4000.00 USD | 900.00 USD | none |
| 3900.00 USD | 40000.00 USD | none |

**On the bands.** The purchase bands do not overlap: at least 9000.00 USD belongs to the first, and at least 4000.00 USD but less than 9000.00 USD to the second, so purchases of exactly 9000.00 USD fall in the first band and purchases of 8999.00 USD in the second. Each band carries its own balance figure, 5000.00 USD for the first and 1000.00 USD for the second, and both are read as at least.
